title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Surcharge Uplift for the Declared Class
content:
## Clause

One of the percentages that raise the Dangerous Goods Acceptance loading surcharge depends on the IMDG class or division declared on the acceptance. The schedule is set out by class below; any class not shown there has an uplift of 0. Under AHL DG Limited Quantity the percentage is 0 whatever the class.

| Declared class or division | Class uplift (percent) |
|---|---|
| 7 | 80 |
| 2.3 | 60 |
| 5.2 | 30 |
| 4.2 and 4.3 | 25 |
| 2.1 and 6.1 | 20 |
| 8 | 15 |
| 4.1 | 10 |
| every other class | 0 |

## The same schedule by category (percent)

| Category | Class uplift by declared class or division |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 2.2: 0 · 3: 0 · 4.1: 0 · 5.1: 0 · 6.1: 0 · 8: 0 · 9: 0 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 9: 0 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 3: 0 · 4.1: 10 · 8: 15 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 5.1: 0 · 5.2: 30 · 6.1: 20 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 2.1: 20 · 2.2: 0 · 2.3: 60 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 1.4S: 0 · 4.2: 25 · 4.3: 25 · 7: 80 |

## Points of judgement

**Class 8 goods moving as limited quantities — what class uplift applies?** Zero, because the acceptance is under AHL DG Limited Quantity.

**The same class 8 goods under AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives?** 15 percent.

**Which class is read?** The class or division declared on the acceptance.
